name: memory-guard
description: Keeps typecheck, build, test and Playwright runs under the session's cgroup memory limit, so the kernel does not kill them: runs them with one process, waits for memory or refuses, and reruns a command killed with exit 137.

margin.title: Margin (%)
margin.description: Share of each cgroup's memory max kept free. The high mark counts only for a cgroup with no max.

waitSeconds.title: Wait for memory (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long a heavy command waits for memory to free up before it is refused.
